futureRequiredFields: reported or independently priced cost USD
stopRule: No call before parent gates. Before every future call account for preparation, failed attempts, retries and cache charges. Use a per-call cap within remaining budget where supported; soft cap may not be atomic. Stop before the next call when near US$2 or when cost cannot be bounded; report to parent. Reservation is not a spending target. Do not allocate or call JEV.
